section_header: AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION — Component Groups (Center Support Assembly)
title: AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION — Component Groups (Center Support Assembly)

content.description: Hands removing oil seal rings from center support assembly

content.text: 15. REMOVE THREE OIL SEAL RINGS FROM CENTER SUPPORT
Do not spread the ring ends too much.

content.description: Hands removing one-way clutch assembly and oil seal rings from sun gear

content.text: 16. REMOVE ONE-WAY CLUTCH ASSEMBLY AND OIL SEAL RINGS FROM SUN GEAR

content.description: Checking operation of one-way clutch showing lock and free directions with rotation arrows

content.text: Hold the No. 2 brake hub and turn the sun gear. The sun gear should turn freely counterclockwise and should lock clockwise.
If the one-way clutch does not work properly, replace it.

content.description: Using screwdriver to pry off retainer from one-way clutch assembly

items: (a) Bend several tabs back with a tapered punch.
(b) Pry off the retainer with a screwdriver. Leave the other retainer on the hub.

content.description: Installing one-way clutch into brake hub with front arrow indicator

items: (d) Install the one-way clutch into the brake hub, facing the spring cage toward the retainer.
